podcast.title: Historical Perception in Late 19th/Early 20th Century
podcast.body: In the late 19th and early 20th century, show tunes, with their "bouncy melodies," were believed by some elders to be capable of causing "heart attacks," indicating a strong, almost physical, aversion to their energetic nature.
